brief: Roofless concrete stave silo about 16 ft across and 55 ft high, pale grey-tan staves in a tight grid bound by thin hoops, with a single full-height column of round open door ports stacked one above another up the front (the chute and its doors long gone, a couple of rusty port covers left). Only a ring of bent hoop-rod stubs at the top, lined with perching birds. It stands inside a lot of rusty pipe cattle panels with black cattle around its base and a low stone wall behind.
